name: Draw and Guess
tagline: A secret word. A wild sketch. A room full of guesses.
description: Take turns sketching a secret word on your phone while everyone races to guess. Letter hints arrive as the clock runs down. Fast guesses score more; the artist scores when the room gets it.
howToPlay: The artist picks one of three secret words and draws it. No letters or numbers!
Everyone else types guesses. Letter hints appear as time runs out.
Fast guesses earn more points. The artist earns points for helping everyone solve.
